'''Erik Christopher Daniels''' (born April 1, 1982) is an American former professional [[basketball]] player. He has played for the [[Sacramento Kings]] of the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]], along with the [[Fayetteville Patriots]] and the [[Erie BayHawks (2008–2017)|Erie BayHawks]] of the [[NBA Development League|NBA D-League]]. He played his [[college basketball]] at the [[University of Kentucky]].

==College career==
After graduating from [[Princeton High School, Sharonville, Ohio|Princeton High School]] in [[Sharonville, Ohio]], Daniels went on to the University of Kentucky, where he played his way into the starting lineup his junior and senior year.

==Professional career==
After going undrafted in the [[2004 NBA draft]], Daniels was signed by the Kings as a [[free agent]]. He got very limited playing time in the [[2004–05 NBA season]], amassing a mere 13 points and 18 rebounds over the span of 21 games. Daniels was released by the Kings on October 17, 2005, and signed with the [[NBA G League|D-League]]'s Fayetteville Patriots.

In the 2006–2007 season he played with the [[Pallacanestro Biella|Angelico Biella]] of the Italian [[Serie A (basketball)|Serie A]] league, and in the summer of 2007 he was signed by [[Lottomatica Roma]] for the next two seasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.euroleague.net/item/14665|title=Lottomatica lands forward Erik Daniels|website=Welcome to EUROLEAGUE BASKETBALL|date=December 10, 2023 }}</ref> He was selected with the 7th pick in the first round of the [[2008 NBA Development League draft|2008 NBA D-League Draft]] by the [[Erie BayHawks (2008–2017)|Erie BayHawks]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/draft_board_08.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151105201943/http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/draft_board_08.html|title=2008 NBA D-League Draft Results|website=[[NBA.com]] |archive-date=November 5, 2015}}</ref>  On February 11, 2009, Daniels would become the first BayHawk selected to the NBA D-League All-Star game.  He would be named an alternate on the All-Star game's blue team.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/allstar_replacements_090211.html|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090319053548/http://www.nba.com/dleague/news/allstar_replacements_090211.html|title=Erik Daniels named as an alternate|website=[[NBA.com]] |archive-date=March 19, 2009}}</ref>

On March 19, 2010, he joined [[Hapoel Gilboa Galil Elyon]] from the [[Israeli Basketball Super League]], with whom he won the [[2009–10 Israeli Basketball Super League|2010]] [[2009–10 Israeli Final Four|championship]].

On November 7, 2013, Erik returned to Ukrainian Superleague, having signed a contract with [[BC Odesa]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.bcodessa.ua/index.php/news/item/365-erik-deniels-podpisal-kontrakt-s-bk-odessa|title=Эрик Дэниелс подписал контракт с БК "ОДЕССА" - БК ОДЕССА|date=December 2, 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131202224023/http://www.bcodessa.ua/index.php/news/item/365-erik-deniels-podpisal-kontrakt-s-bk-odessa|archive-date=December 2, 2013}}</ref>

On November 29, 2014, he signed with Argentinian team [[Quimsa]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/world/america/142962/erik-daniels-signs-with-quimsa.html|title=Erik Daniels signs with Quimsa}}</ref>
